hats:
MOV BX, 0x1300   ; BX points at the hi-hat's step 0
MOV CX, 8        ; CX counts the hits left
MOV AL, 1
again:
MOV [BX], AL     ; a hit where BX points
ADD BX, 2        ; move 2 steps on
LOOP again       ; CX - 1; if it isn't 0 yet, back to again
four:
MOV BX, 0x1000   ; BX points at the kick's step 0
MOV CX, 4        ; CX counts the hits left
MOV AL, 1
again:
MOV [BX], AL     ; a hit where BX points
ADD BX, 4        ; move 4 steps on
LOOP again       ; CX - 1; if it isn't 0 yet, back to again
tresillo:
MOV BX, 0x1000   ; the kick's step 0
MOV CX, 8        ; how many slots to visit
MOV DL, 5        ; the jar starts at 8 - 3, so the first slot gets a hit
MOV AL, 1
slot:
ADD DL, 3        ; pour in 3, the number of hits
CMP DL, 8        ; compare the jar with 8, the number of slots
JL skip          ; less than 8? not full: no hit, skip ahead
SUB DL, 8        ; full: empty one jar's worth
MOV [BX], AL     ; and play a hit
skip:
ADD BX, 2        ; the next eighth note
LOOP slot
five_eight:
MOV BX, 0x1000   ; the kick's step 0
MOV CX, 8        ; how many slots to visit
MOV DL, 3        ; the jar starts at 8 - 5, so the first slot gets a hit
MOV AL, 1
slot:
ADD DL, 5        ; pour in 5, the number of hits
CMP DL, 8        ; compare the jar with 8, the number of slots
JL skip          ; less than 8? not full: no hit, skip ahead
SUB DL, 8        ; full: empty one jar's worth
MOV [BX], AL     ; and play a hit
skip:
ADD BX, 2        ; the next eighth note
LOOP slot
four_euclid:
MOV BX, 0x1000   ; the kick's step 0
MOV CX, 16       ; how many slots to visit
MOV DL, 12       ; the jar starts at 16 - 4, so the first slot gets a hit
MOV AL, 1
slot:
ADD DL, 4        ; pour in 4, the number of hits
CMP DL, 16       ; compare the jar with 16, the number of slots
JL skip          ; less than 16? not full: no hit, skip ahead
SUB DL, 16       ; full: empty one jar's worth
MOV [BX], AL     ; and play a hit
skip:
ADD BX, 1        ; the next step
LOOP slot
forever:
MOV BX, 0x1300
MOV AL, 1
again:
MOV [BX], AL
ADD BX, 2
JMP again
